title: Skill cartography: infer the operator's knowledge/skill map from the lake, refine via adaptive probes
description: Design 2026-08-11. GOAL: a living, evidence-based model of what the operator actually knows/can do, with rapid refinement and gap-targeting. LAYER 1 — INFERENCE FROM EVIDENCE (no testing needed): mine atuin shell history (tool vocabulary, command sophistication over time), git history across all repos (languages, APIs touched, review comments), polylogue sessions (concepts discussed, questions asked vs answered, correction patterns — what the operator catches agents on is HIGH signal for real knowledge), browser/reading history (exposure map), the public comment corpus (domains argued competently). Output: skill nodes with evidence anchors + confidence, taxonomy roughly: languages/runtimes, systems (nix, systemd, db, networking), ML/AI-practice, math, domains (psychometrics, pharmacology, ...), meta-skills (agent orchestration — evidence says 99.9th percentile class). LAYER 2 — RAPID REFINEMENT: adaptive probing sessions, IRT-style — LLM generates targeted probe questions where confidence is low, difficulty adapts (staircase), 10-15 min sessions, updates the map; probes double as retrieval practice (feed SRS). LAYER 3 — GAP ANALYSIS: diff the map against target-role profiles (agent-infra/GA-class work) → ranked missing atomic skills, each becoming a drill-forge (sinnix-9si) or SRS item. Map lives in the lake as a versioned derived product (re-derivable per uou doctrine); lynchpin renders progress. Falsification: the map is wrong where probe results surprise it — surprise rate IS the refinement metric.
notes:
2026-08-11 operator rescope (accepted): atuin/git will evidence little object-level skill because there IS little object-level activity — the operator directs agents, doesn't type code or commit. Cartography layers rescoped: (a) RICH evidence lanes: agent-orchestration practice, architectural judgment (choice-points in polylogue dialogues — but NEVER agent testimony/praise as evidence; receiver-behavior and ground-truth probes only), domain knowledge from discussion corpora; (b) object-level coding fluency: thin evidence AND plausibly atrophied — classify as ESTABLISH-BY-PROBE, not infer; (c) first gap-analysis output, pre-registered: object-level fluency for interviews is likely missing-atom #1 for the matched agent-infra roles; treatment = dyh drills (borrow-checker prediction, translate-with-compile-check) which double as the measurement.
Layer 1 evidence-mining built and verified live: scripts/sinnix-cartography (commits f0a42ed, e115b5b for the polylogue index-symlink fix it depended on). Real end-to-end run against 14-day window produced 5 calibrated skill nodes with honest confidence levels (0.2-0.5) and explicit caveats matching the bead's own rescope philosophy (git commit volume != verified hand-authored skill). Layer 2 (adaptive probing sessions) and Layer 3 (gap analysis vs target-role profiles) not built this pass -- Layer 1 evidence mining was the buildable, testable slice; probing sessions need a real interaction surface (the hub or steering CLI) and gap analysis needs a target-role profile that doesn't exist yet as a concrete artifact. Real correction-pattern mining (the bead's own designated HIGH-signal lane) returned empty in this test run -- worth checking with a longer window or refined query terms in a follow-up, noted not chased given time budget.

title: Personal steering system: plans/goals in time, commitments-with-calibration, realtime self-steering substrate
description: Operator directive 2026-08-11 (design bead; personal-context rationale lives in local scratch, not here). PROBLEM SHAPE: ideas exist in abundance; execution is blocked by always-something-more-relevant-anxiety; no durable relationship between intentions and time; realtime self-steering aversive. DESIGN PRINCIPLES: (1) PREDICTION-CALIBRATION AS SPINE — every plan entry is a forecast ('X by Friday, 70%'), outcomes logged, calibration curves rendered (lynchpin); this converts plans from self-judgment into measurement, and the calibration corpus is unique-to-estate (joins with actual telemetry). (2) DECIDE-ONCE SCHEDULING — Complice-style day-intentions chosen at a single decision point, small (1-3), satisficing by construction ('chosen from a good-enough menu' beats optimal-paralysis); the menu of worthwhile activities/workflows/experiments is a curated standing list (activities registry) so no session starts from a blank page. (3) STRUCTURED SUBSTRATE + CONVERSATIONAL FRONT — not ad-hoc-dialogue-holds-everything (context-lossy, unauditable) and not bare taskwarrior (dead without a driver): a small typed store (commitments, forecasts, outcomes, activities registry, reviews — jsonl/sqlite in the lake) that Hermes and agents read/write as THE interface, dialogue as the front-end. Prior art absorbed: Complice (intentions>tasks, co-working), Beeminder (commitment devices — adopt the graph, skip the money sting initially), taskwarrior (typed store, no driver), org-mode (all-in-files), Fatebook/PredictionBook (forecast logging), GTD weekly review (as an agent-assisted ritual, not self-discipline). (4) REVIEWS ARE AGENT-DRIVEN: daily/weekly review sessions where the agent presents evidence (what happened per telemetry vs what was intended) and drafts the next window; oracle is the embryo of this. (5) EXPERIMENTS ARE FIRST-CLASS: the registry includes experiments (sleep-schedule stabilization first, using existing sleep/activity exports as the measurement layer) with pre-registered predictions. Depends-on: sinnix-xxq UI bead (renders it), lynchpin (calibration+telemetry views), sinnix-9si (drills are activities).
notes:
2026-08-11 DECISIONS (dominant options resolved, not open tradeoffs):
STORE = sqlite at /realm/state/steering/steering.sqlite (transactional, FTS, trivially served; /realm/state is the service-state root) + daily jsonl export to /realm/data/captures/steering/ (raw-forever doctrine; lynchpin ingests the export for cross-telemetry joins). SCHEMA v1: commitments(id, text, created_at, window_start, window_end, forecast_p REAL, status IN(open,done,missed,retired), outcome_at, outcome_note, activity_id, review_id) — forecast inline, not a separate table; activities(id, name, kind IN(task,practice,experiment,leisure), est_minutes, energy_tier IN(good,any,low), standing_notes) — energy_tier is the both-state mechanism; experiments extend activities(hypothesis, prereg_prediction, metric_ref, status); reviews(id, ts, window, generated_summary, operator_notes). Calibration = computed view over commitments, never stored. SCHEDULER = systemd user timers (estate-native), morning intention ritual + evening review ritual invoking claude -p with store context; rituals are WRITTEN dialogue (doubles as therapy-prep material). CLI = sinnix-steer script (frontmatter-packaged): intent add/done/miss/list, forecast, activity add/menu, ritual morning|evening, export. Calibration renders in the cockpit (live); lynchpin consumes exports for telemetry joins — split decided.
2026-08-11 design addition: READY QUEUE for outward/irreversible actions — a store table of pre-composed, pre-reviewed, send-as-is artifacts (messages, applications, posts). Rationale (general form): for operators where actuation is the limiting reagent, composition and transmission must be decoupled — review happens offline with agent assistance, and self-declared high-actuation windows spend the queue (one tap per item) instead of improvising. Cockpit surfaces the queue count; window-mode view lists items with single-action send. Complements decide-once scheduling: both convert scarce decision/actuation capacity into cheap selection from pre-vetted menus.
2026-08-11 root-first design (operator cited LW 'Losing the Root for the Tree'): (1) morning ritual opens with a BUBBLING-UP pass — derive today's intentions from the root question ('what does the root goal need most right now?') BEFORE showing any task menu; task-first ritual design is explicitly rejected (locally-rational twig descent is the failure mode being defended against). (2) ROOT-ELICITATION as a first-class feature, not an assumption: the operator's root is partially occluded (self-flagged), so the ritual may ask ONE small root-probing question per day; answers accumulate in the store and triangulate the root over weeks — written, incremental, never demanding the whole answer. (3) Weekly review does explicit bubble-up: each active commitment gets a root-contribution ('thickness') estimate; low-thickness twigs get deprioritized by policy. (4) Deep-branch descents (subgoal chains >2 levels from any root-linked goal) get flagged in the review as descent-warnings.
2026-08-11 STORE DECISION REVISED (operator's insight, better than the sqlite plan): the steering store v0 IS A DEDICATED PERSONAL BEADS WORKSPACE — beads is agent-ergonomic by design and the interface layer of this system IS agents, so the ergonomics transfer; and it works in MINUTES not weeks (the operator's binding constraint: past self-organization attempts failed because setup exceeded the available window; time-to-first-working-loop dominates schema elegance). LIVE AS OF TONIGHT: /realm/state/steering (prefix 'me', dolt-backed, git repo), front-door script /realm/state/steering/steer (BEADS_DIR wrapper), energy:good/any/low labels for the both-state filter, forecasts as 'p=X by DATE' in notes, doctrine stored via bd remember in-workspace. AMBIENT SURFACE: SessionStart hook (dots/claude/hooks/sessionstart-steering.sh, committed) prints ready-state into EVERY agent session — the operator lives in agent sessions, so state rides an existing unavoidable path instead of relying on reminders or session-resumption (operator: 'even a simple reminder would be disregarded' — design input). Custom sqlite schema DEFERRED until beads demonstrably fails to model something (calibration view = small script over bd export; taskwarrior rejected: no agent fluency, no versioning story). jfiy.1 rescoped accordingly: steer goes into scripts/ properly, tmpfiles/persistence registration for /realm/state/steering, cockpit reads bd export.
2026-08-12 OPERATOR DESIGN CORRECTION (supersedes the ambient-surface rationale): (1) The SessionStart hook only reaches states where the operator is ALREADY working interactively — it misses the dissociated default state entirely; do not count it as the answer to the initiative problem. (2) The actual design target is JETTISONING THE PRIVILEGED DEFAULT STATE: no default mode with negatively-coded exceptions — intentionality as the universal mode. Concretely: (a) environment restructuring so no center-of-gravity default exists (browser inversion, sinnix-qvwq, is part of THIS, not a separate convenience); (b) session-entry passes through intention declaration — 'what is this session for'; (c) project work becomes day-planned ('today: drive X via A,B,C') and horizon-targeted ('reindex realized by <date>') instead of reactive drift; (d) the metric that matters is sustained attention to what is specifically being done over time, not reminder delivery. (3) State axis correction: bad days are NOT low-energy — aversive/agitated, if anything too-high-energy. Steering labels renamed to state:settled/any/averse-ok; menu filtering selects for aversion-compatibility, not effort level.
Calibration curve command built and verified: 'sinnix-steer calibration' buckets resolved commitments by forecast_p, computes actual done-rate per bucket vs forecast midpoint (commit 5234db3). Tested against real seeded+resolved data, correctly identifies over/underconfidence direction and magnitude. Decide-once scheduling + the activity menu were already built by jfiy.1's morning ritual (RITUAL_PROMPTS['morning'] explicitly implements decide-once: 1-3 intentions from a curated menu, satisficing by construction, forecast attached to each) -- this fills the calibration gap the design doc calls out as missing (design principle 1, 'the spine'), not a duplicate of jfiy.1. Store was never initialized live before this pass (schema created on first run) -- seeded now, 15 standing activities + the sleep-stabilization experiment present. NOT done: lynchpin-side calibration curve rendering (design says 'lynchpin' renders it -- this CLI command is the data-side half; a lynchpin view is separate scope), the xxq UI bead this depends on for a non-CLI front-end.

title: Steering/estate UI-UX program: Noctalia surfaces, Hermes daemonic front-end, localhost bidirectional cockpit
description: Companion to the steering-system bead; operator noted (private log) the shape: bootstrap a bidirectional UI between operator and agents, outgrowth of the html-report skill, served dynamically on localhost. RESEARCH+DESIGN SCOPE: (1) NOCTALIA: which steering surfaces belong in the shell (today's intentions, forecast-due prompts, capture-status glanceables, gentle timers) vs what stays pull-based; extend the existing ops-reducer panel pattern. (2) HERMES DAEMONIC: viability = yes structurally — persistent background presence via systemd user service + agent-gateway, waking on timers (reviews), events (sinex/NATS triggers), and operator address (mke voice loop later); needs: session continuity (--resume/state), notification egress into Noctalia, guardrails on unprompted interventions (quiet by default, speak on schedule or ask). (3) LOCALHOST COCKPIT: dynamic local web app the agents can BOTH render into and receive edits from (the bidirectional part): steering store views (commitments/calibration curves), lake browsers, live report pages; candidate substrate: the html-report skill grown a server + websocket layer, or a small FastAPI+htmx app agents patch. (4) UX doctrine: zero-blank-page (everything opens pre-populated from the store), one-decision-per-surface, aversion-day mode (surfaces shrink to a single next action). Multiple child beads expected out of this design pass.
notes:
2026-08-11 DECISIONS: COCKPIT SUBSTRATE = Python ASGI (FastAPI/starlette) + htmx + SSE, server-rendered fragments, no build step — dominant for agent-maintained UI (agents patch HTML fragments directly; html-report skill aesthetic reused as the style layer); lives as a real package under pkgs/sinnix-cockpit/ following the sinnix-agent-gateway pattern; systemd user service on localhost, registered runtime surface. CONSOLIDATION: the cockpit is ALSO drill-forge's host — drills are routes in the same app sharing one sensor JS lib (mic/webcam/keyboard timing), one session-logging path, one style system. One localhost app total: steering views + drills + live reports. HERMES DAEMON SHAPE (v1): not a resident model process — a scheduler (systemd user timers + sinex/NATS event hooks later) that opens persistent hermes/claude -p sessions for rituals and pushes Noctalia notifications with a cockpit-link reply affordance; voice (mke) and unprompted-intervention tiers come later, quiet-by-default guardrail standing. SEQUENCE: cockpit pull-surfaces first, daemon push second, voice third.
2026-08-11 BROWSER-INVERSION + OS-center doctrine (operator, recorded verbatim-in-spirit): stop the permanently-open browser window as center of gravity; browser reconceptualized as THIN VIEWER — opened for a resource like a PDF viewer, closed after; center of gravity moves into the OS: HYPRLAND GROUPS as the universal tab container whose siblings are webpage windows, agent sessions, terminals. Enablers: qutebrowser tabs.tabs_are_windows=true (every page = a window = a Hyprland-group tab), hyprland group keybinds as the one tab vocabulary, URL-handler routing (fuzzy front-door from r4u8 opens into fresh viewer windows). Doctrine: incremental capability accretion, no absolute solutions (operator: deconstruct habits stepwise); INTEGRATE models into workflows rather than avoiding for latency/cost anxieties — cost estimation itself becomes an estate-visible number so anxiety is replaced by measurement. Enrichment back-end split out as sinnix-qa2s.
2026-08-12 research finding: the sinity/sinnix-ops Noctalia plugin (bar capsule + panel over the ops-reducer snapshot) is NOVEL in the Quickshell ecosystem -- no native desktop-shell agent-fleet widget precedent exists anywhere (only web/Electron dashboards). This program's Noctalia surface work is greenfield, not pattern-copying; the existing plugin is the seed to fleet-scope (per-agent rows, quota windows, job states already flow through the reducer). Reference implementations for widget patterns: tomgonz/quickshell-simpleperfmeters (proc-reading meters), ekremx25/quickshell (modular bar architecture).

title: Drill-forge: instrument factory for atomic-skill training (shared components + agent-generated drills)
description: Operator direction 2026-08-11: the oqa 'atomic skills with transfer leverage' principle generalizes, and the economics flipped — coding agents make bespoke interactive training instruments hours-cheap, so skills never worth instrumenting now are. Build the FACTORY, not instruments: a component library every drill composes — (a) sensor adapters: mic (pitch/formant/VAD), webcam (MediaPipe landmarks/gaze/AU, rPPG heart-rate), keyboard/mouse timing, screen; (b) scoring primitives: DTW contour match, adaptive staircase (QUEST/3-down-1-up JND ladders), ms-latency measurement, LLM-as-judge with rubric; (c) scheduling: FSRS spaced repetition, adaptive difficulty; (d) session logging to lake (personal-baseline stats per 8sf philosophy, progress curves in lynchpin); (e) presentation: local web page (tachistoscopic/RSVP timing-accurate), TTS/audio generation for stimuli. A drill = declarative config + generated glue; the LLM authors new drills on demand (same emit-reusable-formal-objects pattern as 8sf mechanics-registrar and kk4 dynamic grammars). Personalized-corpus drills are the killer class: stimuli generated FROM the lake (own typing errors from scribe-tap, own shell history, own repos, own photos, own conversation audio). Cross-domain atomic-skill catalog recorded in the reply of 2026-08-11 drive session and summarized: social (expression-reading at adjustable exposure ms, turn-taking gap timing, backchannel timing, eye-contact dosing via gaze duty-cycle, prosody-intent, name-face binding from 7dg photos), perceptual (auditory stream segregation via TTS-mixed voices — cocktail-party trainer, pitch JND ladder, rhythm ms-precision, RSVP reading with comprehension gates, visual search), cognitive (Fermi estimation with confidence-interval calibration curves, prediction calibration joined to lynchpin, chunking), motor/input (weak-digraph typing trainer from OWN keystroke logs, CLI-vocabulary spaced repetition from OWN atuin history, shortcut recall generated from OWN configs), communication (sentence-compression drills LLM-judged, Feynman drill vs LLM-simulated novice whose quiz score is the metric, steelman/ITT drill vs LLM-simulated partisans), emotional/interoceptive (affect-labeling latency, HRV biofeedback breathing via webcam rPPG — no wearable), technical (spot-the-injected-bug diff drills generated by mutating OWN repos, log-anomaly speed reading, regex/jq/SQL golf on own data shapes). Ties: oqa (vocal instances), 8sf (social instances + reveal pedagogy), kk4 (finetuning the judges), h8k (progress analytics).
notes:
2026-08-11 CONTEMPLATIVE-INSTRUMENT LANE (from operator's claude.ai meditation dialogue + MCTB2/Shinzen/Folding reading arc; research-grounded): the drill-forge's fourth domain. Instruments, ordered by evidence-grade:
(1) BREATH-COUNTING TASK — the validated objective mindfulness measure (Levinson 2014; replication 10.1007/s12671-017-0880-1): count breaths 1-9, press on 9, catch-trial resets; KEY DESIGN FACT: miscounts (unaware errors) index attentional lapses while self-caught resets index mind-wandering AWARENESS — two separable metrics from one task. Respiration sensing optional tiers: button-only -> mic airflow -> webcam chest motion.
(2) COLOR-NOTING CALIBRATOR (operator's chat design): full-screen solid color changing at random intervals, speak/press the note — ground-truth label accuracy + lag at controlled rates (RSVP-class psychophysics). Trains/benchmarks the recognition-label loop speed that fast-noting requires (the chat's argument: deliberation squeezed out above ~4Hz); explicitly a calibration accessory, NOT practice (it amputates the selection frontend).
(3) NOTING TELEMETRY over real practice: spoken notes via the nm7/mke STT stack -> note rate, vocabulary distribution, inter-note-interval ENTROPY (rhythmic-muttering detector: too-regular intervals + decorrelation from ambient events = notes decoupled from contact — the failure mode the operator described).
(4) PROBE-CAUGHT MIND-WANDERING: random audio probes during sits ('on object?'), meta-awareness latency distribution over weeks.
(5) LONGITUDINAL PSYCHOPHYSICS (the pre/post markers from the literature): attentional-blink T2 accuracy (Slagter-line: meditation reduces blink), two-flash fusion threshold (VanRullen ~alpha-band discrete sampling — tracks the 'strobing' phenomenology), emotional attentional blink variant.
(6) PHYSIOLOGICAL LAYER: webcam rPPG HRV + respiration during sits (no wearable); optional hardware tier: Muse S (4-channel dry EEG, 200+ studies; JMIR 2025 meta-analysis of consumer neurofeedback+mindfulness = positive but modest/mixed — treat as signal source, not oracle) or OpenBCI for raw access; muse-lsl/BrainFlow are the open stacks.
(7) THE ESTATE-UNIQUE INSTRUMENT: practice-log x life-telemetry correlation in lynchpin — join sit logs against sleep exports, HRV, typing-error rate (scribe-tap), activity rhythms; nobody else can run this join. GOODHART GUARD (from the dialogue, keep verbatim): instruments are 'ground truth over exactly the thing trained' or they are proxies that corrupt practice; calibration accessories, never the practice itself; retreat-grade effects come from volume, not gadgets.
2026-08-11 SRS-LLM integration design (operator: never hand-author flashcards): (1) CARD PROVENANCE — cards are DISTILLED from learning sessions: a session with an LLM (reading, probing, explaining) ends with the agent extracting the genuinely-retention-worthy atoms into FSRS cards, each card pointing to its source session (polylogue) so context is one hop away. (2) INITIAL LEARNING IS THE DIALOGUE — the session teaches; SRS only maintains; never SRS-first. (3) DECK HYGIENE IS AGENT WORK — periodic pass retires leeches, merges duplicates, rewrites cards that probe results (sinnix-d0t) show test the wrong atom. (4) Generated decks (shortcuts-from-dots, C++->Rust mapping rows, CLI-vocab-from-atuin) enter the same FSRS store with generator provenance. (5) Review UI = one drill-forge instrument, or plain Anki with a sync bridge (FSRS is native to modern Anki) — decide at build time.
2026-08-11 DECISIONS: SRS = Anki + FSRS + AnkiConnect for agent card injection (mature review UI incl. mobile, FSRS native; building a review UI is waste — decided, not open); cards carry source-session pointers in a dedicated field. DRILL HOST = the qvwq cockpit app (consolidation of record); drill-forge builds the component library (sensors, staircases, DTW, logging) as cockpit modules. First two instruments = breath-counting task, then color-noting calibrator (evidence-grade order).
2026-08-11 PSYCHOPHYSICS OBSERVATORY lane (ranked selection from full brainstorm, operator session): TOP INSTRUMENTS by validity x leverage x buildability x novelty x beauty: (1) PVT psychomotor vigilance — gold-standard fatigue/sleep-pressure measure, 3min/1-button, the state thermometer all telemetry joins against; BUILD FIRST. (2) Heartbeat-detection (Schandry counting + synch/delay discrimination) with webcam-rPPG as ground truth — interoceptive-accuracy training without hardware, alexithymia-relevant (8sf). (3) 'Seams gallery' — curated interactive illusions (MIB, Troxler, lilac chaser, bistables) as constructedness-made-inspectable demonstrations with hidden longitudinal measures (disappearance rates, dominance durations); the pretty ambassador piece. (4) Drift-detection — imperceptibly slow full-field hue drift, notice-latency = direct measure of the monitoring faculty; the before/after criterion for the contemplative program; NOVEL. (5) Temporal-resolution panel: CFF + two-flash fusion (arousal/fatigue-sensitive classics + the strobing-phenomenology longitudinal hook; needs WebGL vsync discipline + measured refresh-rate metadata per session). (6) State-impulsivity panel: delay-discounting k + BART, 5min, tracked as time series vs sleep/schedule covariates. (7) Audiovisual binding window (TOJ staircase — autism-literature-relevant, nearly unbuilt as self-serve). (8) Guess-your-own-telemetry calibration (metacognition about own time, Brier-scored — estate-unique). (9) Own-prose recognition vs LLM imitation (ties kk4 reddit-ghost eval). (10) MOT multiple-object tracking (prettiest trainable-capacity task). BATTERY DESIGN is the real product: daily micro-battery (PVT + 1 rotating probe, <=5min, low-energy-tier compatible), monthly deep panel (AB, TOJ, CFF, discounting), event-triggered sampling keyed to telemetry; single-subject longitudinal design with covariates = methodologically STRONGER than group studies for n=1 questions. Build doctrine: performance.now+rAF+fullscreen, refresh-rate recorded per session or data is garbage; photosensitivity gate on flicker; daily instruments brutally short (abandonment is the threat model, not noise). Long-list of ~60 further candidates in session transcript 2026-08-11.
2026-08-11 SRS transaction-layer redesign (operator rejects both Likert self-rating and card-by-card model chat): scheduler (FSRS, binary Again/Good — the 1-5 scale is legacy SM-2 confusion, config not code) is kept; the TRANSACTION layer changes: (1) PRODUCTION-GRADED RECALL — answers are produced (typed/spoken/written code), graded mechanically: exact-match or compile-check where possible (C++->Rust rows), local-model semantic grading elsewhere; no self-rating anywhere. (2) SESSION-SHAPED REVIEW — one interaction per session, not per card: agent pre-compiles the due set into a single artifact (cockpit quiz page / cloze sheet / best: a generated micro-TASK that requires the due atoms, e.g. a code-reading snippet using this week's due constructs — retrieval embedded in use); operator completes in one pass; grading runs in one pass after. Model participates at generation-time and grading-time only, never inside the review loop. (3) Optional ambient tier: one due item as a Noctalia glanceable for passive re-exposure, ungraded. Implication: plain Anki+AnkiConnect demoted to fallback; the cockpit review route becomes the primary surface since production-grading needs the sensor/grading stack anyway.
2026-08-12 drive merge: sinnix-cs9 (Skill-instrument foundry) superseded into this bead -- same-day duplicate crystallization of the same directive. Unique content folded from cs9:
EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE (binding): far-transfer brain-training is historically bunk (n-back debacle); train only skills that are components of real tasks (near transfer) and MEASURE transfer against live capture-plane telemetry instead of assuming it; personal baselines over population norms (8sf philosophy). "Did the drill transfer?" is a lynchpin question per skill (typing drill -> real keylog error rate; turn-taking practice -> real conversation telemetry).
BUILD-FIRST SHORTLIST (leverage x measurability x data-already-flowing): (1) typing error-pattern trainer -- mine scribe-tap for actual bigram/word error distribution, drill text generated from it, real-world error rate = transfer metric (data flowing TODAY); (2) shell-fluency SRS -- mine atuin for repeated man/--help lookups + long-way-around pipelines as flashcard candidates; (3) calibration ledger -- predict task durations/build outcomes, Brier-scored against ActivityWatch/CI actuals; (4) face-name SRS once 7dg face clusters exist; (5) turn-taking timing trainer once dyad corpora land; (6) monologue-length self-calibration once nm7 audio telemetry flows.
Shared-runtime detail from cs9 absorbed: item presentation (local web/TUI), response capture (keys/mic/webcam), adaptive difficulty (staircase + IRT-lite), FSRS scheduling, pairwise-judgment (Bradley-Terry/Elo), scoring plugins (DTW/classifier/exact), session logging as lake-conventional JSONL. A new trainer = agent writes {item generator, scorer, UI config} against the runtime -- hour-scale.

title: URL x visit x archive-snapshot ledger + time-matched retrieval + domain special-case ladder
description: Operator spec 2026-08-11 (sub-program of 0d5/ngf; run the ledger NOW). STAGE 1 — evidence join, no crawling: take ALL browser-history URLs (lynchpin webhistory captures + live Chrome history), conservative normalization only (lowercase scheme/host, strip fragment + known tracking params utm_*/fbclid/gclid/yclid; KEEP query strings otherwise — search/reddit/forum URLs are meaning-bearing). For each URL: (a) visit timestamps (potentially many, from history); (b) archival snapshot timestamps per provider — Wayback CDX API (bulk, returns full snapshot lists), Common Crawl CDX index, archive.today (no bulk API — go through the Memento TimeTravel aggregator/TimeMap protocol which federates providers), plus provider-specific (e.g. IA availability API). Output: duckdb/parquet product url x [visits] x [provider,snapshot_ts] — a lynchpin analysis product with coverage stats (what fraction of visited URLs have ANY archive within N days of a visit). STAGE 2 — act on the gaps: (a) for still-alive unarchived URLs, batch SavePageNow (SPN2 API) — outsources archival+timestamping to IA before crawling anything ourselves; (b) live-crawl the high-value residue into the lake (WARC+SingleFile per ngf). CRAWL DESIGN decisions recorded: crawl from a COPY of the browser profile (agent-private profile pattern) — carries auth where needed but does NOT pollute main history; per-host adaptive politeness (rotate hosts, budget per host, exponential backoff on 429, robots-aware for the naive tier). TIME-MATCHED GOAL: each visit maps to nearest-in-time snapshot within a window — 'the page as I plausibly saw it'. DOMAIN SPECIAL-CASE LADDER (hypothesis: head domains have superior non-crawl routes covering the majority of history): reddit=dumps+arctic (done); twitter=feedmem+archives; lesswrong=public GraphQL API serves full posts/comments (no crawl needed; optionally contact RobertM re research access/goodwill); HN=official API/BigQuery; Wikipedia=revision history gives EXACT as-of-visit page; StackExchange=dumps; YouTube=takeout history + yt-dlp policy; github=API/clones; gwern.net et al stable-content sites=single snapshot suffices; Google searches=rewrite as tbs=cdr date-restricted advanced search to approximate then-results (imperfect — ranking drift — but the only available approximation; store as derived query-rewrite records). Long tail only gets naive crawling. SEGMENTATION: extract main-content vs comments vs boilerplate — per-domain structured parsers where APIs give structure, ReaderLM-v2 (local-reader) + readability fallback for the rest; derived records point at raw WARC per lake rules.
notes: 2026-08-12: Stage 1 (evidence join: history union + conservative normalization + Wayback/CommonCrawl/Memento CDX + duckdb/parquet coverage product, weekly timer) is in the capture program. Stage 2 split to its own bead on closure.

Branch feature/capture/url-ledger-stage1, commit c1f4328, worktree /realm/worktrees/sinnix-url-ledger. Stage 2 tracked separately at sinnix-9tex.

title: Skill-instrument foundry: agent-built interactive trainers for atomic skills, transfer-measured against live telemetry
description: Operator insight 2026-08-11: bespoke interactive trainers were month-scale human projects, so the long tail of market-of-one trainers (value < cost) was never built. Coding agents collapse build cost to minutes-hours, flipping the economics — and this estate has two multipliers nobody else has: (1) PERSONAL TRAINING DATA from the capture plane (scribe-tap keylog, atuin, ActivityWatch, audio, photos, webhistory) that no commercial trainer could access; (2) TRANSFER MEASUREMENT: because the same capture plane records real-world behavior continuously, 'did the drill transfer?' becomes a measurable lynchpin question per skill (does turn-taking practice move real conversation telemetry? does the typing drill reduce real-world error rate in the keylog?) instead of an article of faith. DESIGN — shared trainer runtime, then each trainer is a thin generated layer: runtime provides item presentation (local web/TUI), response capture (keys/mic/webcam), adaptive difficulty (staircase + IRT-lite), SRS scheduling (FSRS), pairwise-judgment support (Bradley-Terry/Elo), scoring plugins (DTW, classifier, exact), and session logging as lake-conventional JSONL so lynchpin correlates practice with telemetry. A new trainer = agent writes {item generator (often local-LLM or TTS), scorer, UI config} against the runtime — hour-scale. EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE baked in: far-transfer 'brain training' is historically bunk (n-back debacle); train only skills that ARE components of real tasks (near transfer), and measure transfer rather than assume it; personal baselines over population norms per the 8sf philosophy. BUILD-FIRST SHORTLIST (leverage x measurability x data-already-flowing): (1) typing error-pattern trainer — mine scribe-tap for the operator's actual bigram/word error distribution, generate targeted drill text; real-world error rate is the transfer metric, data flowing TODAY; (2) shell-fluency SRS — mine atuin for repeated man/--help lookups and long-way-around pipelines = flashcard candidates for commands the operator keeps re-deriving; (3) calibration ledger — predict task durations/build outcomes, score Brier against ActivityWatch/CI actuals (personal forecasting with automatic resolution); (4) face-name SRS from the photo library once 7dg's face clusters exist; (5) turn-taking timing trainer once dyad corpora land (press-to-speak against real turn-transition gap distributions from CANDOR-class data); (6) monologue-length self-calibration once nm7 audio telemetry flows (guess-then-see). Relates: sinnix-8sf (social atomics live there), sinnix-oqa (vocal instance of the same pattern — its runtime should BE this runtime), sinnix-7dg, sinnix-nm7, sinnix-h8k (transfer-measurement analytics), sinnix-kk4 (LLM item-writers, personal finetunes as item generators).

title: Async pre-build: nix build .#sinexd + cachix push on every sinex master move, decoupled from interactive switch
description:
The desktop is already "builder of record" for sinex: after a successful LOCAL nix build (triggered reactively by an interactive `nix develop --command switch`), a background unit (sinexCachePush) pushes the resulting closure to sinity.cachix.org. This covers repeat builds of the SAME input hash, but the FIRST switch after any sinex master bump still pays the local compile cost (8-11.5GB peak, historically) synchronously, on the interactive critical path -- exactly the trigger condition for the 2026-07-06/07-10 incident (root cause since partially fixed: the actual GH Actions CI-push contract that used to keep this warm died in sinex#883 when GH Actions got disabled for the whole account due to a billing lock, discovered 2026-08-11 investigating CircleCI as an alternative -- see sinnix-* CircleCI investigation note).

Real options evaluated 2026-08-11:
1. Restore GH Actions CI-push -- blocked on resolving the account-wide GH Actions billing lock first, not just re-enabling the workflow.
2. Sinex getting its own CircleCI project (polylogue already has one, `.circleci/config.yml`, active, ~30k credits/month budget, existing specifically as the GH-Actions-billing-lock workaround) -- possible but is new project setup, not reuse of existing infra.
3. Self-hosted async pre-build: a systemd timer or git-hook-triggered job (can run on sinnix-prime itself, zero marginal $ cost) that runs `nix build .#sinexd` + cachix push whenever sinex's master moves, fully decoupled from any interactive switch. By the time an operator/agent actually needs to switch, the cache is already warm -- pure substitution, no synchronous compile.

Recommendation: (3). Doesn't need the billing-lock resolved, doesn't need new CircleCI project setup, reuses existing hardware/lease-participation patterns already in place for other heavy work. Should participate in the same sinnix-heavy-lease discipline as everything else (it's exactly the kind of full-workspace build sinnix-qlf's proposed tiering keeps under strict single-holder serialization) so it doesn't become a second thing competing with interactive dev-loop use.

Not recommended: trying to make ordinary interactive `cargo`/`xtask check` dev-loop builds themselves cacheable via cachix -- they aren't Nix builds at all (write to a plain target/ dir, not a Nix store path) even when run inside a nix devshell, so there's nothing for cachix to cache from them. Only an actual `nix build` invocation produces a cacheable artifact. Already-in-place crane split (deps-only derivation cached; source derivation rebuilds on crate changes) is the right-shaped compromise between hermetic reproducibility and build speed; going further toward "every keystroke is a nix build" would sacrifice cargo's fast file-level incremental recompilation for no real gain.
close_reason: Fixed and merged: async sinex pre-build+cachix push on flake.lock rev changes (modules/services/sinex-cache-prebuild.nix), reusing the existing sinexCachePush logic. Not yet switched live.

title: Tier sinnix-heavy-lease: semaphore for scoped -p checks, keep strict lock for full-workspace builds
description:
sinnix-heavy-lease is a strict single-holder flock covering all heavy build/test/nix work host-wide. Investigated 2026-08-11 (audit.jsonl for the day + telemetry.sqlite cross-reference):

- 495 acquisitions, 1246 contention refusals, 144 nested-free passes over a 13.5h window. Hold durations: median 13s, p90 110s, max ~70min.
- Real cgroup memory caps DO exist on nix-build.slice (MemoryHigh=22G/MemoryMax=28G, confirmed live in runtime-defaults.nix) -- corrects an earlier investigation pass in this same session that wrongly concluded no caps existed. min mem_avail across 4582 samples that day: 6.3GB (never critical), zero OOM kills, memory_psi_full_avg10 never sustained above ~10%.
- The 22G/28G slice cap alone doesn't prevent TWO concurrent builds from thrashing each other well before hitting the hard ceiling -- that's what the strict serialization is actually for, layered on top of the slice cap, not instead of one.
- The strict-1 design doesn't distinguish today's actual bimodal demand: ~90%+ of acquisitions are short (median 13s) scoped `xtask check -p <crate>` jobs that never approach the incident-class footprint (an 8-11.5GB single sinexd rustc peak from a 2026-07-06/07-10 incident, since partially mitigated), vs. a handful of genuinely heavy full-workspace builds.

Proposal: keep strict single-holder serialization for full-workspace builds/clippy/`nix develop --command switch` and anything without a `-p` scope restriction (the actual incident class). Add a small semaphore (2-3 slots) specifically for `xtask check -p <single-crate>` invocations, which the audit data shows dominate real usage and complete in a median 13s. Given the 22-28G slice cap already exists as a backstop and today's traffic never approached it even at full unsynchronized contention, 2-3 concurrent scoped checks is very unlikely to threaten it.

One number worth confirming before implementing: a controlled single-scoped-check peak-RSS measurement (isolate one `xtask check -p <crate>` run, no contention, capture cgroup memory.peak) to confirm the semaphore slot count is safe rather than just statistically lucky on the one day sampled.
notes: 2026-08-12: flagged as optional throughput track for the capture program (multi-agent execution multiplies serialized switch cost).
close_reason: Superseded by full removal: operator ruled the host-wide heavy-work lease was unjustified over-serialization (its 2026-07-06 CUDA-OOM justification was a cache-miss malfunction of a rare-by-design workload, and predates nix-build.slice 22G/28G containment). Commit ba44af1 deletes sinnix-heavy-lease and all wiring; max-jobs 1->4; /tmp/sinnix-switch.lock kept as activation-correctness guard, converted from abort to queued-wait. This bead's audit data (1246 refusals/13.5h, median 13s holds, no memory pressure) was the deciding evidence.

title: colmena hive nodes import built toplevel derivations — apply-all likely eval-broken
description: flake/deploy.nix:48-50 and 64-66: both colmena nodes declare imports = [ inputs.self.nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel ]. That imports a *derivation* (coerces to its store path) as a NixOS module: eval forces an IFD build of the whole host toplevel, then tries to import the resulting directory as a Nix expression, which has no default.nix. colmena apply / apply-all has therefore most likely never worked in steady state; ethereal was only ever deployed via nixos-anywhere bootstrap. Verify by running apply-all --on sinnix-ethereal (expect eval failure) before fixing. Correct shape: point each node at the host's module list (hosts/<name> imports + shared modules), or use colmena's flake integration (colmenaHive / node imports of modules, not toplevel). Found during 2026-08-11 drive read-through; router plane and ethereal host files otherwise verified coherent.
close_reason: Fixed and merged: colmena hive nodes now import the real module list (via new flake/host-modules.nix) instead of a built toplevel derivation. Falsified via colmena's own hive evaluator, before/after.

title: Integration doctrine: sinnix/sinex/lynchpin/polylogue split + capture-first sequencing
description: Decided 2026-08-11 with operator. PRINCIPLE: irreversibility rules priority — uncaptured data is the only permanent loss; analysis is replayable later over stored raw. SPLIT: sinnix owns machine+capture daemons+model-serving endpoints; polylogue owns the AI-session organ; sinex owns the event substrate + semantic layer (the eventual absorber); lynchpin is INTERIM analysis — thin, replaceable, no new architecture investment. RULES: (a) capture programs (nm7/9pd/ngf + dbus/MPRIS/AT-SPI singles) land in sinnix NOW as dumb-durable units writing raw+JSONL to the lake in standard formats (per the no-sinnix-specific-workload-APIs memory: standard envelopes, NOT sinex schemas — sinex ingests by replaying stored raw later, capture is never redone); (b) new analysis (h8k menu, census outputs) is lake-in/lake-out portable so it survives lynchpin dissolution; (c) lynchpin investment restricted to P1 zoz + the silent-coverage-collapse class (h58/9kx/tqy/5n9 — same failure family as sinnix-e8e; afe is census's twin) — nothing structural; (d) sinex first-user-mile (bead filed in sinex repo) outranks alternative-path building: every interim capability built around sinex's absence deepens the moat. SEQUENCE: capture-first, sinex-mile second, lynchpin repairs opportunistic.
notes:
2026-08-11 'what polylogue could be' (operator prompt, vs Khoj): Khoj's shape = self-hosted RAG assistant over personal notes: indexing (md/org/pdf), cited chat, custom agents with personas+tools, SCHEDULED AUTOMATIONS (recurring research delivered), editor plugins (Obsidian/Emacs), messaging bridge. Polylogue-could-be, staying true to its evidence-plane identity: (a) semantic search over all AI-session history (embedding index over its archive — session-native, belongs in polylogue); (b) cross-session derived products that are SESSION-SCOPED: topic threads, decision index ('what did we decide about X' with line citations), per-project conversation timelines — session-derived = polylogue's jurisdiction per the raw-owns-derived-nearby principle; (c) the estate's conversational-memory MCP surface (it already is an MCP — grow query verbs: decisions_about, thread_of, last_time_we_discussed); (d) oracle-style scheduled digests generalized (oracle already samples rawlog+activity — the Khoj automation pattern, estate-native). What polylogue should NOT absorb: cross-source fusion (browser+shell+health joins = lynchpin), the derived temporal-KG (h8k), note/knowledgebase RAG (knowledgebase+semantic layer). title: Social-interaction instrument suite: expression, conversation telemetry, practice loops (autism-support tooling)
description: Operator-personal program (2026-08-11, ultrathink request). Framing principle: instruments for self-knowledge and chosen skill-building, never normalization pressure; personal-baseline statistics over NT-trained classifier judgments; absolutely local (this domain is why the local estate exists). Components: (1) EXPRESSION MIRROR (production side): webcam -> MediaPipe landmarks + OpenFace3/py-feat ACTION UNITS (objective muscle activations — deliberately preferred over contested emotion labels, which mislabel autistic faces) -> 'what does my face broadcast' gauge, live-optional/retrospective-default; practice mode = target-expression prompts scored like vocal GOP. (2) DECODING TRAINER (reading side): flashcard loops from video corpora — pause on face, classify, reveal; VLM (local-multimodal-moe) generates cue EXPLANATIONS (brow/timing/context) not just labels; infinite sarcasm/prosody drills GENERATED via TTS emotion control (same sentence, flipped prosody -> classify intent). (3) CONVERSATION TELEMETRY (strongest piece): the nm7+diarization+parselmouth stack yields objective metrics per conversation — talk-time ratio, interruption/overlap counts, response-latency distribution, monologue-duration histogram, backchannel rate, question rate, prosodic variance (monotone gauge); post-hoc replay-with-metrics via lynchpin; optional MINIMAL live nudges via Noctalia (talk-ratio drift, monologue timer) — default off, cognitive load is the enemy. (4) SPARRING PARTNER: the mke E2E voice loop as unlimited judgment-free conversation practice — personas, difficulty (ambiguity/sarcasm/small-talk), post-session pragmatics critique by local LLM. (5) MASKING-COST TELEMETRY (speculative, data exists): lynchpin-correlate interaction density vs recovery markers (typing cadence, activity, sleep exports) -> evidence-based social budgeting. (6) ALEXITHYMIA SUPPORT (long-horizon): periodic self-reports joined to behavioral capture -> learn personal precursor signatures of overload. Models to grab: OpenFace 3.0 or py-feat (AUs), FER ensemble (secondary), rest already in mke/nm7/w9l programs. Prior art context: affective-computing-for-ASD research exists (expression-training games, MIT-lineage emotion-glasses); nobody ships the telemetry pieces because privacy — local estate is the unlock.
notes:
2026-08-11h refinements: (1) MEDIA-CORRELATION + PERSONAL AFFECT MODEL: watched media (MPRIS/stashbox/browser captures) x facial-AU response x periodic SELF-RATINGS = training data for a personal emotion model — learn the mapping from YOUR AUs+context to YOUR self-reported states, replacing NT-trained classifiers entirely over time. Label frameworks to support: FACS AUs (objective substrate), valence-arousal(-dominance) dimensions (better personal-calibration fit than categories), Ekman categories only as legacy interop, appraisal tags optional. Self-rating capture = lightweight periodic prompts (ties alexithymia component). (2) LLM-CONVERSATION SPECIAL CASE: agent conversations are already fully captured (polylogue) — richest conversational corpus owned; use as (a) low-stakes practice baseline, (b) contrast class vs human conversations (interruption/monologue/latency deltas human-vs-LLM are themselves informative), (c) practice-transfer measurement (does sparring improve human-conversation metrics?). (3) DRILL DESIGN deepened: LLM as item-writer (scenario + intended-intent label) -> TTS emotion rendering -> adaptive difficulty (prosody-only items vs context-conflict items; IRT-style adaptation); VALIDITY fix for TTS-emotion-distribution bias: mine REAL examples from captured/watched media (subtitles+audio+CLAP/AU analysis); prior art anchor: MUStARD multimodal sarcasm dataset (sitcom clips) — both an eval set and a mining pattern. (4) AVATAR-DIRECTOR ARCHITECTURE for sparring: separate director-LLM (maintains explicit hidden character state — goals, emotional state, concealed intent — via CoT/structured state; emits utterance + stage directions incl. TTS emotion params) from actor layer (TTS render); pedagogical gold = post-session REVEAL: your inferences vs the actually-modeled hidden state, turn by turn.
2026-08-11j DIRECTOR-REALISM design (operator insight: is the modeled state actually human-realistic?): use BASE models as the character-statistics engine — post-trained models are mode-collapsed into assistant persona; base models retain the raw human text distribution. Scheme: director samples HIGH-N continuations from a base model conditioned on the scene (what would people actually do/feel here, as a population) -> aggregates into state statistics -> instruct model plays the sampled character. Local base options that fit (none strictly dominated): Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base (MoE, the RAM-offload fit — primary), Qwen2.5-14B/7B base (dense, fast-n sampling), OLMo-2 (fully-open incl. training data — auditability), Llama-3.1-8B-base (legacy ecosystem). NSFW/abliteration note recorded: base models have NO refusal training — abliteration is indeed irrelevant (no refusal direction exists to ablate); they complete anything in-distribution but need conditioning-by-prompt (few-shot) rather than instruction. Closed labs do not serve true base models (no relevant non-open options). Kimi K3 (2026-07-27, 2.8T MoE 104B-active, Modified-MIT): open INSTRUCT weights confirmed; a separate BASE release unconfirmed in coverage — and it is irrelevant locally (104B active far exceeds 32GB RAM offload); K2-Base remains the largest confirmed open base.
2026-08-11k DISTRIBUTION-REALISM caveat (operator's sharp concern): base models learn text-about-behavior, not behavior — domains with strong social-desirability distortion (dating, sexuality) have web-text distributions systematically skewed (performative narratives, advice-column register, erotica tropes vs lived reality); high-n sampling reproduces the NARRATIVE distribution faithfully, which is not the behavior distribution. Mitigations recorded: (a) register triangulation — sample under multiple conditioning frames (candid-anonymous register vs public register) and study the DELTA; (b) OLMo+Dolma to measure what the corpus even contains; (c) treat outputs as distribution-of-stories with explicit uncertainty, never oracle; (d) the frustration is legitimate and unresolvable in principle — no one has ground truth for the gap between overt culture and actual behavior; the tool can at least make the gap VISIBLE by contrasting registers. ALSO: NSFW in pretraining is typically FILTERED (Llama/FineWeb-class corpora classifier-filter adult content; Dolma partially) — base models underrepresent it vs the actual web; another reason OLMo's measurable corpus matters, and a caveat on base-realism for those domains specifically.
2026-08-11 director-mode prior art (ERP community — convergent evolution confirmed): st-stepped-thinking (middleware prompt-chaining: forces generation of character thoughts/emotions/plans BEFORE the reply — our director's deliberation stage, already built as an ST extension pattern), SillyTavern-Tracker + RPG-Companion + MultihogDnDFramework (structured per-turn state: stats/inventory/quests/world progression + RNG systems — proven state-schema shapes to steal), Guided-Generations (operator interjection steering mid-scene), ST-Copilot (OOC meta-assistant/DM-aide channel — the out-of-band control plane). What OUR design still adds beyond their practice: (1) deliberately CONCEALED state with post-hoc pedagogical reveal (their thoughts display immediately; ours hides for the inference-training loop), (2) base-model population sampling for state realism, (3) the voice loop w/ speaker-verified barge-in. Implementation shortcut recorded: prototype the director INSIDE SillyTavern via stepped-thinking + Tracker forks before building bespoke — the middleware hooks exist.
2026-08-11: TALEMATE identified as the closest existing system to the director architecture — open-source RP engine built AS separate agents (director agent, narrator, world-state, memory via vector store) orchestrating the scene, i.e. the community's own agent-separated answer to bare-LLM roleplay; study/steal its agent decomposition before building. Meta context: pure adventure ENGINES (KoboldAI Lite adventure mode, AI-Dungeon-likes) lost to freeform+tracker-extensions because rigid mechanics constrain fiction; the winning shape is LLM narration + mechanical resolution bolted on (dice/state extensions) — the same hybrid our director design already assumes.
2026-08-11 EMERGENT-MECHANICS design (operator idea — better than the engines-vs-freeform dichotomy): the LLM AUTHORS mechanics ongoingly rather than being constrained by prebuilt ones — during play the director proposes/extracts rules ('persuasion here works like X, roll vs rapport'), persists them to a MECHANICS LIBRARY (derived-data shape: rule = {trigger, resolution procedure, dice/threshold, provenance-scene}), and cheap deterministic code + RNG enforces them thereafter (consistency without rigidity; the LLM narrates outcomes it no longer adjudicates alone). Library accumulates across sessions/campaigns = reusable house-rule corpus; rules are re-derivable, versioned, supersedable per the uou derived-data doctrine. This inverts the failed pure-engine model: structure is OUTPUT of play, not input. Prior-art check: AI-Dungeon scripting/Talemate node systems gesture nearby but nothing known does rule-extraction-to-persistent-library; likely novel composition.
2026-08-11 operator clarification on structured-vs-freeform: the interesting third option is the LLM SPINNING ITS OWN MECHANICS ongoingly — improvised formal subsystems (a duel resolution rule, a resource clock, a relationship meter) invented mid-fiction, persisted, reused, and evolved — backed by a MECHANICS LIBRARY the director accumulates across sessions (retrieve-adapt-instantiate, like lorebooks but for RULES). Community trackers gesture at this (MultihogDnD's RNG+lorebook-agent) but nobody does library-accumulating improvised mechanics. Same design shape as kk4's dynamic-grammars idea: dynamically generated formal structure, LLM-managed, persisted as data. Director architecture gains a mechanics-registrar component.
2026-08-11 ATOMIC-SKILL DECOMPOSITION of the social domain (operator ask — the oqa pattern applied here; trainers built on the sinnix-cs9 foundry runtime):
DECODING atomics: (1) micro-expression flash recognition — 30-200ms staircased exposures from the FACS-labeled tiers; (2) incongruence detection — eye-region vs mouth-region emotion mismatch (fake-smile discrimination), trainable by compositing; (3) prosody-meaning atomics: sarcasm/irony detection (TTS-generated + mined real clips per existing MUStARD plan), and STRESS-PLACEMENT semantics ('I didn't say she stole it' x 7 stress positions = 7 meanings — cheap TTS item generation, high leverage for pragmatics); (4) emotional-prosody classification at staircased subtlety.
TIMING atomics (the highest-leverage cluster, uniquely measurable here): (5) turn-taking gap calibration — listen to real dyad audio, press when you would start speaking, score against the corpus's actual turn-transition distribution (CANDOR/Switchboard class); (6) backchannel timing production (insert 'mhm' at natural points, score against corpus placements); (7) interruption-vs-backchannel discrimination; (8) monologue-length self-calibration — estimate how long you just spoke, see actual (calibration training on self-perception, later fed by real nm7 telemetry).
PRODUCTION atomics: (9) target-expression production (already planned, GOP-scored); (10) prosody-contour imitation (shared DTW machinery with oqa); (11) conversational-repair phrase practice against LLM-simulated misunderstanding signals.
MEMORY/BINDING atomics: (12) face-name SRS from own photo library + face clusters (7dg) — prosopagnosia-adjacent support, purely personal data; (13) person-fact SRS (auto-generated from conversation capture: names, relationships, stated preferences — the 'remember what people told you' skill).
INTEROCEPTION atomics: (14) emotion-vocabulary granularity SRS with own-experience example mining; (15) body-state labeling drills joined to later physio correlation (the alexithymia component, atomized).
INFERENCE atomics: (16) single-turn hidden-state prediction — scenario, predict intent/emotion, reveal (the director-mode reveal loop reduced to SRS-schedulable items).
Evidence-discipline note: all near-transfer (each skill IS a component of real interaction, not abstract capacity training); transfer measured against conversation telemetry once nm7/9pd flow, per cs9.

title: Continuous screen + enriched terminal capture (the remaining senses)
description: Operator wants (2026-08-11): close the non-audio capture gaps. SCREEN: always-on low-rate capture — screenpipe-style frames (0.2-1fps or on-change) + OCR (ties to sinnix-w9l OCR tier) + window/app metadata, NOT full video (4K OLED video is ~2-4GB/hr; frames+OCR+metadata reconstructs almost everything at ~1% the cost). Hyprland event stream ALREADY flows to ops-reducer — join frames to window ids/geometry/workspace from it. TERMINAL: verify asciinema capture is actually operational (census!); enrich casts with correlated hyprland window geometry/position + kitty window identity (kitty-scrollback capture exists) so a session can be recreated as-it-looked: cast + geometry timeline + which display/workspace. Storage: /realm captures conventions, tiered like audio (recent raw, older compressed). Sink: lake + lynchpin correlation.
notes:
READ-TRACKING design (2026-08-11e): streams = webcam gaze region (MediaPipe iris, region-grade) + viewport/scroll (browser via CDP/rrweb from sinnix-ngf; terminals via kitty scrollback position; PDFs via viewer IPC where possible) + screen-OCR word boxes (PaddleOCR-VL frames). Join: dwell-time-weighted paragraph coverage — a paragraph counts as read when it sat in the gazed region for >= personal-reading-speed * its-length (calibrate reading speed from known-read sessions). Output: read-spans JSONL {content-hash, span, confidence, ts} into the lake; lynchpin materializes 'actually-read text' vs 'displayed text' — the delta is itself interesting (skimmed vs studied). Honest granularity: paragraph, not word; confidence field mandatory.
2026-08-11g VIDEO tier added (operator asked possibilities in earnest): gpu-screen-recorder with NVENC HEVC on the 3080 (near-zero CPU) in three modes — (a) REPLAY RING: always-on last-30-min buffer in RAM/realm, save-on-hotkey ('clip that') — the highest-value/lowest-cost video feature; (b) EVENT-TRIGGERED continuous recording (meetings/screenshare detection via PipeWire+portal events); (c) optional continuous 1440p@10-15fps HEVC ~0.5-1.5GB/hr if ever wanted — frames+OCR remains the always-on default, video is the escalation tier. Storage math recorded; DRM/portal caveats apply. ALSO new capture sources approved-for-design: AT-SPI2 accessibility tree (the SEMANTIC screen — roles/labels/text/focus events; complements pixels; needs chromium accessibility flag for Electron/Chrome; GTK good, Qt decent) as focus-follow logger + event stream; D-Bus NOTIFICATION stream (org.freedesktop.Notifications — every notification to the lake); MPRIS media metadata (what played when); live clipboard (clipse exists as export — make continuous); mouse-dynamics telemetry (fatigue/behavior signal, cheap).
2026-08-11h HYBRID SEMANTIC-MASKED VIDEO design (operator idea, recorded as novel — no known shipped system does this): regions covered by semantic capture are EXCLUDED from pixel video and reconstructed at replay: terminals re-render from asciinema casts (deterministic given font/theme — near-pixel-perfect), browser windows re-render via rrweb player (~95% fidelity; canvas/video elements are the honest gaps), hyprland geometry timeline provides exact placement, cursor track via hyprctl cursorpos/libinput polling (cheap, essential). Residual pixel video only for unmasked regions (mpv, games, misc). Feasibility: HIGH terminals / MED-HIGH browser / storage win large; complexity moderate (replay compositor needed for reconstruction). Fallback stance: even without the compositor, capturing everything separately preserves the option.
2026-08-11j ARCHITECTURE UPGRADE (operator direction): per-window capture beats post-hoc masking. Hyprland/wlroots expose hyprland-toplevel-export / wlr-screencopy-class protocols = capture ANY toplevel individually, INCLUDING off-screen and other-workspace windows, damage-driven (frames only when content changes — static windows cost ~zero). New design: per-window encoded streams + geometry/z-order timeline -> ANY view reconstructable (incl. workspaces never displayed); full-screen pixel truth kept only in the 15-30min NVENC ring; archived tier = per-window residual streams with semantically-captured windows (terminals/browser) DROPPED, gaps+wallpaper reconstructed (wallpaper file known to noctalia; hyprland animations acceptable as cheap residual or re-simulated). Record-everything-then-blank fallback: masking to constant color before encode collapses macroblocks to ~nothing — near-full savings without per-window plumbing. SELF-VERIFICATION loop (operator req): periodically render the reconstruction (asciinema/rrweb/wallpaper composite) for a sampled moment and SSIM-compare against the ring-buffer ground truth — capture pipeline that proves its own fidelity, occasionally-continuous as budget allows. Deep-Hyprland data grabs: damage events, animation states, full window-state beyond IPC via plugin API (C++) if the protocols fall short.
2026-08-11 web-recon: (1) landscape re-check — screenpipe is now YC S26 and pivoting to agent-platform ('plug into your agents', OpenClaw/'Hermes agent' integrations); still MIT, Linux build exists; adjacent: ScreenMemory, TimeScroll, Windrecorder, OpenRecall, LUCI (consumer local-recall). Our custom plan stays justified (Wayland/Hyprland-native capture, pixel-perfect semantic masking, lake conventions), but screenpipe's pipeline (capture->OCR->sqlite FTS->API) is the reference implementation to crib from. (2) VIDEO-UNDERSTANDING tier for the archived screen/media video: Qwen3-VL has timestamp-grounded event localization (Text-Timestamp Alignment) — the right shape for 'what happened at minute M' queries over screen video; VideoChat-Flash (ICLR 2026) does ~50x hierarchical token compression with 99.1% needle accuracy on 10K-frame inputs — the archival-scale query architecture. Both open-weight.
2026-08-11 screenpipe DEEP ANALYSIS (fetched README, current): LICENSE FLIPPED — no longer MIT; source-available, personal non-commercial free, commercial paid ($25-150/seat); PostHog telemetry ON by default + Sentry; YC S26, pivoting to teams/agents. Architecture worth stealing: (1) EVENT-DRIVEN capture (app switches, clicks, typing pauses, scroll — not fixed-fps; ~300MB/8h vs ~2GB continuous) — adopt as 9pd's trigger model alongside the periodic baseline; (2) ACCESSIBILITY-TREE-FIRST text extraction with OCR only as fallback (matches our AT-SPI plan; validates the ordering); (3) per-pipe DATA-PERMISSION model (YAML frontmatter: app/window globs, content-type, time windows, endpoint gating, enforced at three layers incl. per-pipe tokens — 'not prompt-based') — the design pattern maps directly onto agent-gateway profile capabilities for capture-data access; (4) storage economics reference: sqlite+FTS5 + JPEG frames, 5-20GB/month. Where our stack wins: capture surfaces already exceed theirs (scribe-tap keylog, atuin, kitty scrollback, ActivityWatch, planned all-channel audio with a better STT tier than their whisper-turbo, sinex event platform, lynchpin cross-source analysis), Linux tier is first-class for us (their Linux = source-build + Tesseract, Wayland unaddressed), lake conventions + replay-later doctrine vs their opaque sqlite, zero telemetry, and semantic masking requirement they don't attempt. Verdict: build 9pd bespoke as planned; import ideas (1)-(3).
2026-08-11 screenpipe-steal mapping onto estate (operator asked): (1) EVENT-DRIVEN TRIGGERS: capture keyed to state-change events (app switch, click burst, typing pause, scroll) instead of fixed-rate polling — this is literally sinex's event-platform doctrine applied to screen capture; implementation: subscribe the 9pd capture daemon to the existing event streams (ActivityWatch window-focus events, scribe-tap activity, Hyprland IPC) — sinex/NATS can BE the trigger bus, giving capture the same replay/provenance properties as every other sinex source. (2) A11Y-FIRST, OCR-FALLBACK: prefer structured text from the accessibility tree (AT-SPI lane already planned in ngf/9pd), OCR only for canvas/games/remote — the estate already practices this principle elsewhere: kitty scrollback capture gets terminal text structured rather than OCRing terminal pixels, polylogue gets session text from JSONL rather than screenshots; screen capture should follow the same 'structured source beats pixels' ordering. (3) PER-PIPE DATA PERMISSIONS: screenpipe grants each agent/pipe declarative scoped access (app/window globs, content types, time windows, endpoint gating, enforced with per-pipe tokens, not prompts) — maps onto agent-gateway capability profiles (remote-readonly/local-agent-control/remote-operator) which currently scope TOOLS; extend the same manifest machinery to scope CAPTURE-DATA queries (which lanes, which time ranges, which apps) when capture surfaces become gateway-queryable. That is the missing design piece for exposing 9pd/nm7 data to agents safely.

Enabling services.gnome.at-spi2-core is necessary but not sufficient; each toolkit opts in separately. Fixed in 8294902 (QT_LINUX_ACCESSIBILITY_ALWAYS_ON + ACCESSIBILITY_ENABLED as session vars, --force-renderer-accessibility on the Chrome wrapper). Verified live: a GTK app launched without NO_AT_BRIDGE/GTK_A11Y took ChildCount 0->1 in 4s. CAVEAT for whoever picks this up: session variables only reach NEWLY LAUNCHED applications, so the lane fills in per-app as things restart, and everything currently running (Chrome, Noctalia, kitty) still carries NO_AT_BRIDGE=1 from the pre-flip session. A relogin or reboot is what makes it fully live.

title: Faithful web + network capture/archival: DOM-level, WARC traffic, response bodies, video specialcase
description: Operator wants (2026-08-11) rich/faithful/comprehensive web archival, wider network capture to some extent, keep everything, dedup+compress, downstream markdown processing. Design layers: (1) DOM-level session recording via rrweb (the extant project class the operator recalled: records DOM mutations + viewport/scroll/input as replayable JSON — faithful 'how it looked incl. viewport movement' at tiny size) injected via the CDP :9222 infrastructure (polylogue browser-capture receiver already exists as the ingestion path precedent); (2) page snapshots via SingleFile (self-contained HTML) for point-in-time keeps; (3) traffic-level: CDP Network domain response-body capture for browser HTTPS (no MITM needed inside the browser we control!) -> WARC via warcio; browsertrix/pywb class tooling for crawl-shaped archival; (4) LIMITS documented: full-machine HTTPS MITM (mitmproxy+CA) works for browsers but breaks cert-pinned apps and QUIC/HTTP3 (disable h3 or accept gaps) — CDP-side capture sidesteps all of it for the browser, which is most traffic of interest; raw packet capture (pcap) only for metadata/flows, not plaintext; (5) VIDEO: specialcase media URLs via yt-dlp triggered from captured network requests (ytdlp-clip-watch precedent exists). Dedup: content-hash store + WARC revisit records + zstd. Downstream: ReaderLM/Docling -> markdown derivatives, raw kept per lake rules.
notes:
2026-08-11g IN-DEPTH LAYER DESIGN: L0 network metadata — zeek-class conn/dns/tls logs (flows not bodies; QUIC-blind acceptable since L1 owns browser bodies). L1 browser traffic bodies — CDP Network domain (getResponseBody + webSocketFrame events; HAR-stream) -> WARC via warcio with revisit-record dedup; media streams excluded by design -> yt-dlp specialcase fed from captured manifests. L2 DOM sessions — rrweb injected globally via CDP Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument on the controlled browser (mutations+scroll+masked-input, KB/s, pixel-faithful replay via rrweb-player). L3 semantic snapshots — SingleFile on navigation-settle + ReaderLM/Readability -> markdown derivatives. L4 intentional whole-site jobs — browsertrix-crawler. Dedup/store: CDX index + content-hash blob store + zstd long-window; keep everything (text cheap, media deduped, video by yt-dlp policy). Replay: pywb (WARC) + rrweb player; join keys ts+CDP-target-id+navigation-id -> lynchpin reconstructs session = replay + read-spans (9pd gaze) + kept-artifacts. LIMITS recorded honestly: EME/DRM video unrecoverable; native-app TLS only via mitmproxy w/ pinning pain (Electron apps are CDP-able with the accessibility/debug flags instead); passive QUIC opaque.
2026-08-11h: MORE CDP GRABS worth taking: DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot (flattened DOM+layout+computed styles — the read-tracking join substrate, better than raw HTML), Accessibility.getFullAXTree (browser a11y tree WITHOUT AT-SPI flags), Runtime/Log console+errors stream, Storage snapshots (cookies/localStorage state points), Page.screencastFrame (built-in per-tab low-fps screencast = the browser-video source for 9pd's hybrid scheme), Tracing for perf archaeology. ADBLOCK POLICY decided: personal lake archives AS-EXPERIENCED (adblock on — it is the memory of what was seen, and junk-free storage); uBO block-decision log captured as metadata; L4 intentional crawls offer a no-filters FAITHFUL mode for preservation-grade jobs. Dual capture only when explicitly requested.
2026-08-11 web-recon: consider ArchiveBox as the L2/L3 EXECUTOR instead of hand-rolling the multi-format snapshot stage — one ingest produces original HTML+assets, SingleFile HTML, screenshot, PDF, readability text, WARC, and JSON metadata, orchestrating the same tools we planned to drive individually (chromium, SingleFile, yt-dlp, readability). Self-hosted, active 2026. Browsertrix remains the L4 crawl tier as planned. Decision point: ArchiveBox's snapshot formats vs our CDP-native capture for the browser special-case — likely both (ArchiveBox for URL-list archival jobs incl. 0d5 link-target snapshots; CDP/rrweb lane for live-session capture).
2026-08-11 operator decision: bespoke stack CONFIRMED over ArchiveBox-as-executor — ArchiveBox covers none of the load-bearing lanes (no CDP capture, no rrweb, no network/WARC-from-live-session, no auth-session integration); demoted to optional convenience for bulk URL-list snapshot jobs only if it ever earns its keep. Extraction tier: ReaderLM-v2 (already local as local-reader) supersedes readability-class heuristics for HTML->markdown fidelity (512K ctx, handles messy DOM); keep a readability-class pass as the cheap first-tier fallback (fast, deterministic) with ReaderLM as the quality tier — both writing derived-extraction records that point at the raw capture per lake rules.
2026-08-12: L1/L2/L3 (CDP attach loop: rrweb injection, response bodies to WARC with revisit dedup, SingleFile-on-settle + ReaderLM-v2 markdown, DOMSnapshot + AXTree + console subscription absorbed on the same loop, adblock-on as-experienced, distinct CDP port) are in the capture program behind the browser decision. Residue split on closure: pywb replay + browsertrix L4; L0 flow-metadata (deferred, no TLS interception ever); yt-dlp special-case.
2026-08-12 storage decision (from 0ufh close): WARC volume is NOT hardware-gated -- HDD tier (/neo-outer-realm class) absorbs it, pruning allowed under pressure. Design the lane with a tiering/retention knob from day one (recent on NVMe, bulk on HDD) instead of assuming NVMe-resident forever.
2026-08-12 operator clarification correcting the previous note: NO retention knob. Design the WARC lane with a TIERING knob only (NVMe recent -> HDD bulk); no pruning/retention mechanism gets built or configured unless the operator explicitly authorizes one. Capacity pressure surfaces on the scoreboard for an operator decision; the lane never deletes on its own.
2026-08-13: DNS query content and TLS SNI are NOT covered by the L0 netflow lane (sinnix-0cqk, commit acf4dec) -- conntrack teardown events carry the 5-tuple and counters, nothing about names. Capturing either needs packet-level inspection, a materially different mechanism, and belongs in this bead's scope. Cheapest honest options to evaluate here: a systemd-resolved query log or a dnsmasq/unbound log lane on sinnix-gw for DNS names (no interception, the resolver already sees them), and TLS SNI only via a passive tap, which is a real design decision rather than a config toggle.

title: switch exits 0 when the heavy lease is held — silent no-op masquerading as success
description: Three times on 2026-08-11 a background 'nix develop --command switch' printed the lease-held message and exited 0 without building or activating anything; callers (and agents) read exit 0 as success and only catch the no-op later via the revision stamp. wait-seconds=0 + exit 0 is the wrong contract for switch: either exit nonzero when the lease blocks (so callers can retry), or honor a wait (SINNIX_SWITCH_LEASE_WAIT?) and queue. Evidence: tasks bvo2hdojq/buevi2cv9/bwpd3sncr this session, each followed by stamp-unchanged confusion.
notes: 2026-08-12: pulled into the capture program as mandatory Phase-0 co-requisites -- both undermine trust in phase-exit verification (switch-success and config-revision tripwire respectively). Implementation lane dispatched.
close_reason: Fixed and merged: sinnix-heavy-lease status now exits 0 only when a live owner holds the lease, 1 when free; documented exit-code contract. Verified via flake tests + revert-and-fail falsification.
